attr.title: Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars
attr.desc: Native 32-bit ARM port of the Android version of Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars, running the original libCTW.so engine through a custom Android-on-Linux loader (KMS/DRM, GLES2, OpenAL). You must supply your own copy of the game's APK and OBB; they are extracted on first launch.
attr.inst: Copy main.4.com.rockstargames.gtactw.obb and gtacw.apk into this port's gtactw/ folder, then launch. First run extracts the data and deletes the archives.
